src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Starting an order
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Starts a new draft sales order for a customer.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: New order checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks a new order's details are valid before it is started.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Payment records
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Lists how customer payments are looked up and saved in the database.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Sale-to-stock records
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Saves which egg lots each sale drew from, and only lets them be marked as returned, never deleted.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Order records
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Lists how orders are looked up and saved, including what each order still owes.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Recording a payment
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Records a customer's payment against a confirmed order.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Payment checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks a payment's amount, method and details are valid before it is recorded.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Removing an order line
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Removes a line from a draft order.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Editing an order line
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Changes the quantity, unit or price of a line on a draft order.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Order line edit checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks a changed order line is valid before it is saved.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Cancelling a payment
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Marks a mistaken payment as cancelled with a reason, keeping the record, so the order owes that amount again.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Cancel payment checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks a payment cancellation comes with what it needs, such as a reason.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Cancelling a sale
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Undoes a confirmed sale, putting each egg back into the lot it came from and keeping the record of what was drawn.

src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.name: Cancel sale checks
src/Cluckwork.Application/Modules/Commer.description: Checks a sale cancellation comes with what it needs before it is carried out.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Ca.name: Eggs per pack setting
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Ca.description: Records how many eggs one packed unit holds, since a carton can be 12, 18 or 30 depending on the market.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Ca.name: Product
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Ca.description: What the farm sells, with its type, unit, default price and whether it is on sale.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Ca.name: Product-to-grade link
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Ca.description: Says which egg grades an egg product is sold from, so a sale knows which stock to use.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.name: Discount limit
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.description: The most a seller bound by a limit may take off a line's list price, compared with exact whole-number maths.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.name: Discount reasons
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.description: The fixed list of reasons an order can be sold below list price.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.name: Egg pack units
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.description: The packed units eggs are sold in.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.name: Where a list price came from
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.description: Records why a line's list price is what it is.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.name: Payment methods
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.description: The ways a customer can pay.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.name: Product types
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.description: The kinds of product the farm sells.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.name: Product units
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.description: The units a product can be sold in.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.name: Order stages
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Co.description: The stages an order moves through.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.name: Customer
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.description: A person or business the farm sells to, with a required name and phone and optional email, address and note.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.name: Discount reason record
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.description: Records why an order was sold below list price.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.name: Payment
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.description: A payment a customer made against a confirmed order, which can be cancelled but never deleted.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.name: Sales order
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.description: An order for a customer, from draft to confirmed or cancelled, holding its lines, discounts and what it owes.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.name: Sale draws from stock
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.description: Records which egg lots supplied which order line and how many eggs, so every sale can be traced back.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.name: Line against discount limit
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.description: Shows where an order line sits against the farm's discount limit and which line broke it.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.name: Sale confirmed notice
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.description: A message announcing that an order has been confirmed as a sale.

src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.name: Order line
src/Cluckwork.Domain/Modules/Commerce/Sa.description: One product line on an order, with quantity, unit, list price and any discount.
